package.name: basler_camera
package.description: ROS 2 driver for a hardware-synchronized Basler GigE stereo pair with software adaptive multi-exposure (bracketing) control, as used in "Bracketing Shows the Way: Adaptive Multi-Exposure Policy as Input for Robust Visual SLAM". Publishes raw BayerRG8 images and per-frame exposure metadata. Requires the Basler pylon SDK.
